name: openlibrary
description: Open Library (openlibrary.org), the Internet Archive's open, editable book catalog. This CLI lists home-page genre shelves and book carousels, the language filter list, home-page stats and blog posts, and edition records as JSON.
notes: The partials endpoints (get-genre-shelf, list-carousel-books) return JSON whose 'partials' field holds an HTML fragment. Book links inside it look like /works/OL...W or /books/OL...M.
list-browse-genres, get-library-stats and list-blog-posts all scrape the home page HTML.

Open Library sends automated traffic to a /verify_human bot check for /subjects/* and /books/* pages. During exploration it later served an 'offline' page for everything. If you get HTML titled 'Hmm...' or a verify_human page, you are being rate-limited or blocked: back off and retry later.
get-edition uses Open Library's documented public JSON API (/books/{id}.json). In this recording that request was blocked, so its response shape was not verified.
Keyword search, facets, subject listings, author pages and work details were not captured. robots.txt disallows /search.
sink.archive.org (Sentry telemetry) and /verify_human were left out on purpose.
